title: Hold an international airline licence
what: An airline operating scheduled international air services to or from Australia needs an international airline licence.

sources.title: Air Navigation Act 1920
sources.quote: 12 Requirement to hold international airline licence (1) Subject to subsections (2) and (3), an international airline must not operate a scheduled international air service over, into or out of Australian territory except in accordance with an international airline licence granted by the Secretary in accordance with the regulations.

reach.condition: if it operates scheduled international air services
